title: 第十八章 一条命第十九章 拜师
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 见银发少女眼神逐渐朦胧，季南北立即察觉到了异常。
联系起刚才师尊被自己腰间玉坠吸引的模样，他顿时明白过来。
急忙将“招蜂引蝶坠“收回储物戒中。
事情这才没有朝不可描述的方向继续发展。
银发少女深深吸了一口气。
她是真没料到，自己竟会被一件区区三品法宝短暂扰乱了心神!
可恼，若是自己修为仍在巅峰时期，哪怕是八品仙宝，也绝不可能出现这种状况!
“师尊，您还好吗?”季南北关切地问道。
银发少女瞥了季南北一眼。
那眼神仿佛在说:还不都是你惹的祸。
只是这一瞥，却让季南北觉得，眼前这位师尊似乎不再是那位不食烟火的仙子，反倒更像个灵动可爱的少女了。
“你那枚玉坠，佩戴时须留意场合。”
季南北本想解释，最终也只是苦笑着应了声“是”。
少女还想再说什么，却骤然停住，眉尖紧蹙。
她抬手扶住额角，似乎正强忍着某种痛楚。
“师尊?”
季南北虽不明白发生了什么，却能看出师尊此刻状态明显不对。
“带我去后山......我闭关的洞府。”
少女咬着牙挤出这句话。
季南北也顾不上什么师徒之别了，当即拦腰抱起银发少女，朝后山属于她的洞府疾掠而去。
以季南北的速度，不到半炷香工夫，便已抵达洞府门前。
少女勉强抬手，掐出一道法诀。
霎时灵气涌动，洞府石门轰然开启。
季南北赶忙抱着少女踏入洞府之内。
“师尊，接下来该如何?”
再问时，季南北发现怀中的娇小师尊已然昏迷，且身体正迅速发烫，温度不断攀升。显然，方才开启洞府已耗尽了她的力气，再也支撑不住了。
就在季南北焦急之际，系统面板再次弹出。
【触发任务，请从以下三项中择一完成。】
选项一、欺师灭祖!（奖励:魔道点一千万，八品仙宝“恢弘八宝道剑”。）
选项二、随意搁置。（奖励:魔道点五千。）
选项三、安放床榻。（奖励:魔道点五千。）
季南北扫过选项，这回连吐槽都省了，直接抱着师尊走向洞府最深处。
那里，一座高台上摆放着一张宛若玄冰雕成的床榻。
content_en:
Seeing the silver-haired girl's eyes gradually becoming hazy, Ji Nanbei immediately noticed something was wrong.
Recalling the way his master was attracted to the jade pendant on his waist just now, he suddenly understood.
He hurriedly put the "Attracting Bees and Butterflies Pendant" back into the storage ring.
Only then did things continue to develop in an indescribable direction.
The silver-haired girl took a deep breath.
She really didn't expect that she would be temporarily disturbed by a mere third-grade magic weapon!
Unfortunately, if my cultivation level is still at its peak, even if it is an eighth-grade immortal treasure, this situation will never happen!
"Master, are you okay?" Ji Nanbei asked with concern.
The silver-haired girl glanced at Ji Nanbei.
That look seemed to say: It's not all your fault.
Just this glance made Ji Nanbei feel that the master in front of him seemed to be no longer the fairy who did not eat fireworks, but more like a smart and cute girl.
"That jade pendant of yours, you must pay attention to the occasion when wearing it."
Ji Nanbei wanted to explain, but in the end he just said "yes" with a wry smile.
The girl wanted to say something more, but she suddenly stopped and frowned.
She raised her hand to hold her forehead, as if she was holding back some pain.
"Master?"
Although Ji Nanbei didn't understand what happened, he could tell that the master was obviously not in the right state at the moment.
"Take me to the back mountain...the cave where I retreat."
The girl gritted her teeth and forced out these words.
Ji Nanbei didn't care about the difference between master and apprentice, and immediately picked up the silver-haired girl by the waist and rushed towards her cave in the back mountain.
At Ji Nanbei's speed, it took less than half a stick of incense to reach the gate of the cave.
The girl reluctantly raised her hand and pinched out a magic formula.
Suddenly spiritual energy surged, and the stone door of the cave opened suddenly.
Ji Nanbei hurriedly carried the girl into the cave.
"Master, what should we do next?"
When he asked again, Ji Nanbei found that the petite master in his arms was unconscious, and his body was rapidly becoming hot, and the temperature continued to rise. Obviously, opening the cave just now had exhausted her strength and she could no longer hold on.
Just when Ji Nanbei was anxious, the system panel popped up again.
[To trigger the task, please choose one of the following three items to complete. 】
Option 1, deceive the master and destroy the ancestor! (Reward: 10 million magic points, eighth-grade immortal treasure "Magnificent Eight Treasures Dao Sword".)
Option 2: Leave it alone. (Reward: 5,000 magic points.)
Option 3. Place the bed. (Reward: 5,000 magic points.)
Ji Nanbei scanned the options, not even complaining this time, and walked directly to the deepest part of the cave with his master in his arms.
There, on a high platform was a bed that looked like it was carved out of black ice.
